connection_condition: transactions_1k.CustomerID corresponds to customers.CustomerID; every transaction line resolves to exactly one known customer.
description: A customer's purchase activity is composed of transaction lines; each line belongs to one customer and is meaningless without the customer that incurred it.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.GasStationID corresponds to gasstations.GasStationID; every transaction line resolves to exactly one known outlet.
description: The transaction log is composed of purchases made at gas stations; each line records one outlet and cannot be interpreted without it.

connection_condition: transactions_1k.ProductID corresponds to products.ProductID; every transaction line resolves to exactly one known product.
description: A transaction line is composed of a purchased product together with its quantity and price; the line has no meaning without the product it refers to.

connection_condition: yearmonth.CustomerID corresponds to customers.CustomerID; each consumption record belongs to exactly one customer and one month.
description: The monthly consumption series is composed of per-customer records; a consumption value is only interpretable as the volume of a specific customer in a specific month.
Average price per single item is derived from transaction price: the summed line totals form the numerator of the per-item ratio.
Average price per single item is derived from transaction quantity: the summed item quantities form the denominator of the per-item ratio, so a set of lines whose quantities total zero is undefined.
Customer total spending is derived by summing transaction price over the lines belonging to that customer.
The transaction year is derived from the leading four characters of the transaction date text.
The transaction month is derived from the month section of the transaction date text.
The consumption year is derived from the leading four characters of the consumption period text.
The consumption month is derived from the last two characters of the consumption period text.

connection_condition: Indirect: the currency is an attribute of the customer, and consumption records are linked to customers through the shared CustomerID; no consumption column carries a currency.
description: Comparing consumption between CZK-paying and EUR-paying customers requires splitting customers by settlement currency and then aggregating their consumption records; the two concepts are connected only through the customer.

connection_condition: Indirect: the currency is an attribute of the customer whose transaction lines are summed; transactions themselves record no currency.
description: Spending can only be attributed to a currency by identifying the currency of the customer who generated it.

connection_condition: Indirect: a transaction records GasStationID, and the country is an attribute of that gas station; no transaction column carries a country.
description: Counting transactions that took place in a given country requires resolving each transaction to its outlet and then to the outlet's country.
